description: Get one automation run in full: every step, in dependency order, with what it produced and why it stopped. Use this after test_automation or to explain a run that went the wrong way. On a branched automation the run's overall status is not the whole story — a filter that stops one leg marks the entire run "killed" even when the other leg finished its work — so read the per-step summary this returns, not just the status.

runId.description: Run id, from get_automation_runs or test_automation
